topic: The 10-minute Instagram bio tune-up for local businesses

script.hook: Your Instagram bio is losing you customers.
beats: Line one: say exactly what you do and what city you serve.
Line two: add a phone number or link so people can contact you fast.
Line three: update your profile photo to your logo or a clear face shot.
